item.title: status recent sprints section omits titles — archive stores them but display doesn't show them
item.intent: The 'status' command recent sprints section must show item titles alongside date/ID/status so users can read what was done without cross-referencing the archive.
item.description: After BUG-081 fixed archive to store .title in sprints.jsonl, the _status_output function at line 3536 still only displays date, itemId, and status. The title field is available and should be included for readability. Users can't tell what was done from IDs alone without running 'backlog history'.
steps: In _status_output, update the jq expression at line 3536 from '\(.date) \(.itemId) \(.status)' to '\(.date) \(.itemId) \(.status) \(.title // "-")'
Ensure the output lines are still readable — consider aligning columns or truncating long titles to ~40 chars
Run shellcheck — confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: aishore status recent sprints section shows item title for each sprint entry
sprints with no stored title (pre-BUG-081 archive entries) show '-' not an error
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
